arguments.adapterCommand: sh -c 'command -v lldb-dap >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec lldb-dap; command -v lldb-dap-18 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec lldb-dap-18; set -- /usr/bin/lldb-dap-*; exec "$1"'
arguments.installCommand: printf '%s\n' 'IDE component installation is managed in Packages > IDE Kit Library. Review the component plan there.' >&2; exit 78

arguments.uninstallCommand: echo 'Debug tools are retained with the environment; disable the Kit to stop using them.'; exit 1
